Question Choices: Which shows a smaller part of a whole 2/6 or 5/6?
Hints: First check the denominators: both fractions have the same denominator 6, so the whole is the same size
Different denominators, same numerators. When the top numbers are the same, the fraction with the smaller bottom number is bigger.

Question Choices: A shape is divided into 15 equal parts. 3 parts are red, 5 are blue. What fraction is NOT shaded?
Hints: Fractions = not shaded parts / total parts. 15 - (red + blue) = not shaded parts
When the numerator is bigger than the denominator, the fraction is more than one whole.
Think about how close each fraction is to 1 whole. ; Or think of as 4 equal size shapes, one has 5 equal parts and one has 9 equal parts.
